name: Tezuka Kaoru
source:
The protagonist's beloved younger sister. She is a kind-hearted, well-bred young lady from a wealthy family, and quite a beautiful girl. She dies by suicide. The hero believes that she was bullied by the three heroines.

[Tranlation from Getchuhttps://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=755150]
